Controlled disposal · Greece

Military sea drone found in Lefkada cave, Greece; Ukraine denies ownership

7 May 2026 · Lefkada

Military USV; disputed operator

On 7 May 2026 a fisherman found a military unmanned surface vessel, or sea drone, in a coastal cave on the Greek island of Lefkada. He reportedly moved or towed the vessel before the authorities secured it. Explosives were reported on the drone.

Greek officials described the sea drone as Ukrainian-built or of a Ukrainian type. Ukraine denied ownership, and ownership remains disputed. Its launch point and route are unknown. A later Greek investigation, reported on 15 May, considered that it may have suffered a technical failure or travelled off course.

No casualties were reported. The Coast Guard, police and Navy investigated, the vessel was transferred to a naval facility, and the explosives were later destroyed in a controlled disposal.
